Enum Class JsonMsgType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<JsonMsgType>
com.owltask.infra.msgs.JsonMsgType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<JsonMsgType>, Constable
public enum JsonMsgType extends Enum<JsonMsgType>
Enumeration of websocket message type IDs. Names MUST match the fixed message-name strings from the API spec exactly (e.g. TASK_CREATE), since that's what's transmitted as the "msgType" field.

Add one entry here per websocket message as each use case is implemented; this is the single shared dispatch key set for the whole app (all modules register into the same MessageRouter/JsonMsgType space).
